status: DRAFT. Confirm or change the thresholds below, then record `shasum -a 256 prereg_retest.json` (with the date) BEFORE either labeller writes a label. After that, do not edit this file.
purpose: Confirm on fresh data the in-sample results on 75 municipal chunks with the old ten categories: E4 (Jev, one choice with Winnow-style structured criteria plus none_of_these: precision 0.91, recall 0.91) and E3 (plain one-line criteria: 0.77 / 0.91), against 0.29 / 0.64 for ten yes/no questions; and measure them against the production topics.

question.request: run_retest.py builds it: POST https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/typesafe/v1/systemone, model typesafe-ai/jev, state {passage: {page_title, heading, text[:2500]}}, one choice question 'topic'
question.instructions: Which of the listed topics does the passage's own content in `passage` concern? Pick the single best match.
question.differences_from_E3: twenty topics instead of the old ten; `passage` instead of `item.passage` (no items wrapper); text cap 2500 instead of 1500, to match what describe shows the paid model

designs.structured: run_retest.py --criteria structured: each topic {what: label, examples: covers split at commas, not_for: the shared not_for}; none_of_these {what, examples}. Same mechanical rule as E4 (typesafe-mcp/prereg_e4.json)
designs.plain: run_retest.py --criteria plain: '<label>: <covers>' per topic plus none_of_these (E3)
designs.reviewed_criteria: if a person edits the structured criteria (run_retest.py --write-criteria, then --criteria-file), freeze the edited file and record its sha256 next to this file's, before labelling

sample.source: export_sample.sql: chunks the describe stage has processed, up to 40 per authority level, fixed hash order
sample.size_target: at least 100 chunks both labellers call content, and at least 40 gold-positive (chunk, topic) pairs, so the precision interval is roughly ±0.12
sample.blind: labellers get chunks.json only (prepare.py); never baseline.json, never Jev output

gold.topic_pair: positive if both list the topic as primary; negative if neither lists it as primary or acceptable; otherwise excluded
gold.junk: counted only where both labellers agree
gold.agreement: report Cohen's kappa for junk and for primary topics

predictions.floor_secondary: for each design: only when confidence >= 0.6
predictions.tie_descriptive: for each design: every topic with probability >= 0.5 x the top topic
predictions.B_baseline: production corpus.chunk.topics; a chunk with status boilerplate has no topics
predictions.auc_descriptive: for each design, AUC over (chunk, topic) pairs from the choice probabilities (ranking quality; reported beside precision and recall, never alone)

replicates.scope: the primary design, all scored chunks (chunks every design answered)

decision.worth_building_as_second_opinion: replicates holds AND, among chunks where J and B disagree, gold sides with J in at least one third of the decided cases. If B is missing, decide on replicates alone and say so.
decision.multi_topic: report recall on chunks with two or more gold topics separately; a single choice cannot exceed one topic per chunk there, so this bounds J rather than failing it
decision.designs_compared: report structured vs plain per chunk (sign test); the plain design is the replication check of E3

report: score_retest.py prints all predictions over: all, agreed content, agreed junk, >= 2 gold topics, and each language; plus J vs B per chunk and on disagreements
